direct_path.finding: Clear low-risk local work remains DIRECT and single-agent.

role.finding: Role selection is conditional and separate from agent/model identity.

skill.finding: Skill activation remains default-zero with bounded activation.

model.finding: Stronger-model behavior is escalation/evidence gated; explicit configuration has precedence.

tool.finding: Tool policy is minimum-sufficient and shell interaction is fail-fast/non-interactive.

topology.finding: Adaptive topology remains single-agent unless material fan-out benefit exists.

multi_agent.finding: Independent multi-stream work can use bounded fan-out; availability alone does not activate it.

multi_model.finding: Role/model mapping exists without decorative model diversity.

continuation.finding: Continuation evaluates mission state, evidence, authority and completion rather than model-done/idle alone.

context_depth.finding: Context depth is independent from execution depth and risk.

semantic_context.finding: Scoped TypeScript declarations can be extracted without full source injection.

project_intelligence.finding: Patterns are evidence-backed, bounded and invalidated to POTENTIALLY_STALE when source changes.

memory.finding: Memory provider boundary is optional and cannot satisfy verification.

privacy.finding: Provider-facing task prompts pass through local redaction and leak tests use synthetic secrets.

human_judgment.finding: Material questions are gated and independent questions can be batched.

retry.finding: Retry is budgeted and must be materially different.

process.finding: Ordinary model-facing bash remains DEGRADED: the host exposes a separate PTY lifecycle, but Hi does not claim PID/job lifecycle ownership for ordinary bash.

isolation.finding: Workspace isolation remains UNSUPPORTED until Hi owns selection/provisioning/cleanup and real child/tool execution binding to an alternate workspace.

verification.finding: Verification is risk-proportional and evidence freshness remains authoritative.

completion.finding: Completion adjudication remains deterministic and pending required state prevents completion.

stop.finding: STOP remains authoritative; model completion statements do not own STOP.

opencode_native_behavior.finding: OpenCode 1.18.18 real-host acceptance passed against exact runtime source c5d8287 for loader/agent projections, four Go model-role bindings, direct authority, native child sessions, native permission once/reject, visual resource fail-closed behavior, and truthful process/workspace/browser capability reporting.

portability.finding: Host capability manifest keeps core semantic ownership outside OpenCode-specific types; no full alternate adapter is claimed.

efficiency.finding: Nine deterministic policy scenarios cover execution-shape efficiency without claiming provider billing/latency.

skills.finding: All 27 built-in canonical hi-* methodologies have validated trigger/do-not-trigger/activation/exit/role/cost/composition contracts.
